selection.basis: The two remaining price-reference-range gaps are published exact framesets with CNY ranges last observed 2026-08-06. Their exact-model price sweeps were last recorded 2026-09-01. Recheck current public manufacturer/store evidence for a current exact fixed amount or quote; do not treat negotiated quotes, other generations, package variants, or USD references as mainland observed prices.

targets.exact_identity: Carbonda CFR696 UDH gravel frameset; current generation and package must be identified in any priced selection
ICAN GRA04 full-carbon gravel frameset; current exact package and domestic delivery terms must be identified in any priced selection
targets.evidence_only_assignment: one Luna Max agent; report current public evidence only, make no repository edits

research_rules.price_acceptance: Add a current amount only when a public source ties it to the exact frameset/package and states currency. Keep public listing, direct quote, fixed MSRP, and foreign-currency references distinct; do not contact sellers, enter checkout, or convert a global price into an observed CNY price.
research_rules.recording: Add one dated mainland-observed-price attempt per variant so the completed broad sweeps remain immutable. Update existing price records only when current evidence supports the exact model/package and usable price type; otherwise preserve the current range and record the unresolved boundary.
research_rules.stop_criteria: Process Carbonda CFR696 and ICAN GRA04 sequentially, one source at a time. Stop at an exact public price or a concrete quote-only, package, access, or market boundary.
research_rules.tooling_prerequisite: scripts/data-gaps.mjs currently selects scoped price aliases for candidates but not published variants; extend latest research-state selection to variant mainland-observed-price attempts and add a focused regression test so B49's newer status is visible beside each reference-range gap.

delivery: Local B49 batch only. No push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
